source_segments.text: following World War II , it seems to have become 42nd Guards MRD in 1957 , while at Grozny .
In 1987 it became 173 Guards District Training Centre , and it comprised in 1991 of three Motor Rifle Regiments , one Tank rgt , one Guards Training Artillery rgt and one Air-Defense regiment .
In November 1990 it had a total of 219 tanks , 187 being T-55s .
By June 1993 173 Guards Training Centre had been disbanded and had handed over half its weapons to the Chechens in order to evacuate the other half unhindered .
